title: Edho’s ‘people, places, things’ is a soulful journey through strangers and memories
htmlContent:
Edho's newest single, "people, places, things," offers a heartfelt exploration of how we see ourselves as we navigate new cities and meet unfamiliar faces. With different homes around the world as its backdrop, the song captures the feeling of being a stranger in places that should feel like home but often seem distant and intimidating.

Recorded in London, the track features a lively mix of rhythmic guitar and smooth basslines, creating an inviting sound. Edho worked on the final touches in his home studio in Zurich, where he polished the song throughout 2024. The result is a relatable track, reaching out to listeners from all walks of life. Inspired by artists like Mac DeMarco and the cozy vibes of 70s music, Edho blends memories with a modern touch, inviting everyone to join him on a journey of emotional exploration.

https://open.spotify.com/track/31FCvPB536qZe2g0rIFcD9?si=bQ979my9QX6ARtI0iSDvMg

Edho reflects on how people, places, and things can influence our identities, especially when we are always on the move and adjusting to new surroundings. "people, places, things" is a glimpse into the shared human experience, a search for belonging, and the challenge of balancing who we are with the world around us.
